name: Khodumodumo
body:
KHODUMODUMO
CR 15

This monstrous blob of flesh is pulled ponderously forward by legs that look far too small for its body, its cavernous mouth opening to reveal a multitude of wriggling tongues.

XP 51,200
Unique N Colossal magical beast
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, tremorsense 120 ft.; Perception +32

DEFENSE

AC 31, touch 1, flat-footed 31 (-1 Dex, +30 natural, -8 size)
hp 250 (20d10+140)
Fort +18, Ref +13, Will +13
Defensive Abilities primal hunger; DR 10/—; Immune ability damage, ability drain, disease, nausea, paralysis, petrification, poison, polymorphing, stunning; Resist acid 10, cold 10, electricity 10, fire 10; SR 31

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft.; slow and steady
Melee 10 tongues +24 (3d6+12/19-20 nonlethal plus grab)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.
Special Attacks infuriating cacophony, swallow whole

STATISTICS

Str 34, Dex 8, Con 23, Int 1, Wis 21, Cha 2
Base Atk +20; CMB +40 (+44 grapple); CMD 49 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Eldritch Claws, Improved Critical (tongue), Improved Initiative, Improved Lightning Reflexes, Improved Natural Attack (tongue), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception, Survival), Toughness
Skills Perception +32, Survival +29; Racial Modifiers +8 Perception, +8 Survival
SQ endless gullet, mountainous death, so many tongues

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Endless Gullet (Ex)

Khodumodumo’s stomach is an endless demiplane full of the creatures (and any objects nearby) it has swallowed. Creatures affected by Khodumodumo’s swallow whole ability take no damage, but are sent to its internal demiplane.

This eases Khodumodumo’s hunger, causing it to regain 1 hit point per Hit Die of the swallowed creature. Escaping from its stomach requires planar travel magic, but so long as Khodumodumo is alive such spells must overcome its spell resistance in order to transport creatures out of its demiplane.

Infuriating Cacophony (Ex)

Whenever Khodumodumo successfully uses its swallow whole ability, creatures within 700 feet of it must make a DC 26 Fortitude save or become sickened for 1 round by the grating noise of its swallowing. There are no range penalties to Perception checks to hear this sound for creatures within 7 miles of Khodumodumo. Creatures that are deafened or otherwise unable to hear are immune to this ability, as are creatures that it has already swallowed, little comfort that may be. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Mountainous Death (Ex)

If Khodumodumo is killed, it transforms into a mountain at the spot of its death. The demiplane remains, and creatures can freely come and go from the cave mouth. After 1d6 years, it returns to life in a random location on the same continent.

Primal Hunger (Ex)

Khodumodumo is nearly impossible to distract or derail. If it fails a saving throw against any mind-affecting effect which would prevent it from making an attack, it may make another save on its turn each subsequent round until it succeeds.

Slow and Steady (Ex)

Khodumodumo cannot run or charge. It is immune to any effect that would reduce or impair its speed, including paralysis, becoming entangled, solid fog, and similar effects. It can move through any kind of rough terrain without penalty.

So Many Tongues (Ex)

Khodumodumo has 10 tongues, which are treated as primary natural weapons that deal nonlethal bludgeoning damage. However, it can attack a single creature with no more than three tongues in one round. For every 25 points of damage Khodumodumo takes, one of its tongues is destroyed.

For every 25 damage it recovers via endless gullet, it grows another tongue (to a maximum of 10).

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization unique
Treasure triple

The “swallowing monster” known as Khodumodumo is a massive, many-tongued, blob-shaped nightmare known to gorge itself on all living things in its path. It is driven only by hunger and has been known to ingest entire villages, herds of cattle, and fields of crops.

Occasionally, for reasons no one knows, Khodumodumo hibernates. It finds a mountain pass, squeezes its bulk into the space, and goes to sleep. While hibernating, it is unaware of its surroundings and does not wake up unless it takes enough damage to destroy one of its tongues.

Legends speak of mountains with endless caves full of creatures, crops, and random objects. Some scholars believe these are these mountains are the remains of swallowing monsters.

Khodumodumo’s eating creates a cacophony that living creatures find unbearable. It can be heard from seven miles away, so there is no chance of being caught unaware.

Scholars throughout history have held numerous theories as to Khodumodumo’s purpose. Some believe one of the gods created it to curb excessive population growth. Others believe there is no rhyme or reason behind its existence. Yet others believe its purpose was twisted or that it is a mutation of another creature.

Khodumodumo’s legs and feet are miniscule in proportion to its enormous body. It cannot move quickly, no matter how hungry or threatened it is.

While Khodumodumo experiences pain, fear, and other emotions (with the complexity of a creature of its intellect), its hunger is so all-consuming that it usually ignores everything around it. It only reacts if an obstacle blocks its access to food.
